description: This file contains internal API function declarations for the Http Ato Header Object, including functions to create code and name tables and retrieve atom codes and names.

methods.name: HttpAtoHeaderCreateCodeTable
methods.description: Creates a code table for the HTTP Ato Header Object.

methods.name: HttpAtoHeaderCreateNameTable
methods.description: Creates a name table for the HTTP Ato Header Object.

methods.name: HttpAtoHeaderGetAtomCode
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code corresponding to a given header name.

methods.name: HttpAtoHeaderGetAtomName
methods.description: Retrieves the header name corresponding to a given atom code.
